# tinycbor (vendored)

[Intel tinycbor](https://github.com/intel/tinycbor), MIT-licensed, vendored so
the C agent and its tests build without a package manager or network.

- Upstream commit: `213155c8729b07dea836c5ac6e807a089486bf7b` (version 7.0)
- Vendored files: the public `cbor.h`, the encoder/parser/validation sources,
  and their internal headers. Only the non-float, non-pretty-print, non-JSON
  subset is shipped.
- `tinycbor-export.h` and `tinycbor-version.h` are generated by upstream's
  build; the checked-in copies set `CBOR_API` empty and the 7.0 version.
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`).

To update, re-clone the upstream commit, re-copy the same file set, and
regenerate the two generated headers.
